title: Rabbi Yudan the Cappadocian
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot, chapter 4, halakhah 1, with the additional historical folio locator 28b, he speaks before Rabbi Yose in Rabbi Yudah ben Pazi’s name. In Peah, chapter 1, halakhah 4; Kilayim, chapter 8, halakhah 1; Rosh Hashanah, chapter 1, halakhah 8; and at the end of Megillah chapter 2, he asks Rabbi Yose a question.

notes.text: Kapodkia is Cappadocia; the connected epithet is rendered “the Cappadocian.” The additional printed Berakhot locator is 28b, with its side preserved.

All five consulted passages place Yudan before Yose. Berakhot gives Yudah ben Pazi as the reported authority. The digital Berakhot passage carries a Vilna 32a marker, while 28b is Hyman’s historical locator.
